answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16408 Country: India Title: during fast can anyone take steam inhalation,if he/she is suffering from cold..please reply.. Question: during fast can anyone take steam inhalation,if he/she is suffering from cold..please reply.. Answer ID: 16408 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1558/1560/M=1430) Sawm will break by taking steam inhalation while fasting: لو ادخل حلقہ الدخان ای بای صورۃ کان افطر الخ (الشامي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
